## Fisher From Outside (CR 5)

**XP** 1,600  
CE Large magical beast (mythos)  
**Init** +1; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +9  


**Defense**


**AC** 19, touch 10, flat-footed 18 (+1 Dex, +9 natural, –1 size)  
**hp** 84 (6d10+24)  
**Fort** +9; **Ref** +6; **Will** +2  


**Offense**


**Speed** 10 ft., fly 80 ft. (average)  
**Melee** talon +11 (2d6+9 plus grab), bite +11 (1d8+6/19–20)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
**Special Attacks** constrict (2d6+9), raucous call  


**Statistics**


**Str** 22, **Dex** 13, **Con** 18, **Int** 8, **Wis** 10, **Cha** 10  
**Base Atk** +6; **CMB** +13 (+17 grapple); **CMD** 24 (22 vs. trip)  
**Feats** Flyby Attack, Hover, Improved Critical (bite)  
**Skills** Fly +12, Perception +9, Stealth +5 [2 ranks, +3 C, +1 Dex, –1 size]; **Racial Modifiers** +4 Perception, +8 Fly  
**Languages** Aklo (cannot speak)  
**SQ** no breath  


**Special Abilities**


**Constrict (Ex)** A fisher from outside can transfer a victim it has grappled in its talon to its mouth as a move action. Grappling a victim with its mouth does not give the fisher from outside the grappled condition, and it automatically deals bite damage each round to a victim it has grappled in its mouth. A fisher from outside cannot use its raucous call while it has a victim grappled in its mouth.  

**Raucous Call (Ex)** A fisher from outside can emit an extremely loud, raucous, grating call. Any creature within 60 feet other than another fisher from outside or a shantak must make a DC 19 Fortitude save or take 1d4 points of Dexterity damage and be nauseated 1 and confused for 1d4 rounds. On a successful save Dexterity damage is halved, and the nausea and confusion are negated. Once a creature has saved against a fisher from outside’s raucous call, it cannot be affected by that same fisher from outside’s call for one day. The save DC is Strength-based.  


**About**


**Environment** cold mountains  
**Organization** solitary, pair, or flock (3–12)  
**Treasure** none
